testcase.name: Scenario: ellipse-09 Toggle the curvature comb on an existing ellipse: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/sketch/ellipse/scenario.feature:88:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: ellipse-09 Toggle the curvature comb on an existing ellipse ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view ✔ Given the rotated ellipse has no curvature comb visible ✔ When the user right-click its curve and choose Display Curvature ✔ Then a green comb appears around the ellipse ✔ When the user right-click its curve again ✔ Then Display Curvature is checked and Setup Curvature Display is offered ✔ When the user click the checked Display Curvature option ✔ Then the comb disappears and the ellipse remains visible
